title: TOO SMALL!
text: TOO SMALL!. I did look at sizes - never dreaming 1-2" could effect hanging clothing. These are too small. I always use reviews but for plastic hangers - I skipped reading them. :(

product_metadata.title: Honey-Can-Do Plastic Hangers- Black 15 Pack HNG-01520 Black
features: Perfect for polos, t-shirts, and tank tops in a 15-piece value pack
Tubular design is strong yet light, weighing only 34 grams each
Straight silhouette maximizes closet space; includes built-in hooks
Integrated accessory hook hangs belts or scarves nicely, provides space-saving for hanging multiple garments together
Large rod hook is designed to fit over any closet bar.Measures: 15.5-Inches L x 3.75-Inches W x 7-Inches H /39.4 cm L x 9.5 cm W x 17.8 cm H
description: As you're recycling through your closet, these hangers will have your clothes hanging in tip-top shape in no time and giving a wink to the eco-friendly crowd while you’re at it. Smooth plastic gets clothes on and off the hanger quickly while accessory hooks make it easy to also hang anything with a strap, plus scarves or belts. Moving the laundry along efficiently opens up time for the more important things in life… like a bowl of ice cream.
